title: Review of c26's eco-lenia2 dt/2 check: on fresh seed 5 the competition effect holds at DT=0.05 (A 15 vs 29 cells at t=200; 20 cells at t=222 vs 128), same sign for B, somewhat smaller than at DT=0.1
summary: Ran world_dt.py at DT=0.05 for both arms on fresh seed 5 and compared with DT=0.1 runs of the same seed. With competition A has 15 cells at t=200 against 29 in the separate-food twin and reaches 20 cells at t=222 vs 128 (DT=0.1: 338 vs 124); mean A over t=100-400 17.5 vs 27.8; B gains about 4 cells. The effect survives dt/2 with the same sign on both species; on this seed it is not larger at dt/2. Supported.

observations.X: rerun/shared_dt05 vs rerun/sep_dt05 (seed 5, DT=0.05): A 15 vs 29 cells at t=200, 20 cells at t=222 vs 128, B 59.3 vs 55.2

seeds_run.result: pass: effect sign and order of size hold at DT=0.05; delay smaller than at DT=0.1

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed; the time-to-20-cells measure is noisy; resolution not changed.
